description: This file defines the VaultSearchCriteria class, which extends SearchCriteria to add various criteria for searching Vault entities based on project ID, vault ID, user ID, or combination of vault item ID and project ID.

classes.name: VaultSearchCriteria
classes.description: A specialized search criteria class for Vault entities, providing methods to add specific WHERE clauses based on different vault attributes.

methods.name: addProjectCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter vaults by a specific project ID.

methods.name: addIdCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter vaults by a specific vault ID.

methods.name: addIsProjectLessCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter vaults where project_id is NULL.

methods.name: addUserIdCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter vaults owned by a specific user ID.

methods.name: addVaultItemAndProjectCriterion
methods.description: Adds a criterion to filter vaults by a combination of vault item ID and project ID.
